story_description: Build the foundational protocol layer for hook communication including input schemas, output schemas, and JSON serialization for passing structured data between the Blaze harness and external hook scripts
task_description: Create the HookInput struct with all required fields for passing context to hooks including session metadata, tool information, and event-specific data
atom: A001: HookInput Struct and AnyCodable Wrapper
atom_description: Implement the HookInput Codable struct with properties for sessionId, transcriptPath, cwd, permissionMode, hookEventName, toolName, toolInput, toolResult, userPrompt, reason, startType, compactType plus the AnyCodable type-erased wrapper for dynamic JSON values and HookInputExamples enum for testing
problem_statement: Hooks receive input via stdin as JSON but there is no Swift type to deserialize this input into a strongly-typed struct. Without proper Codable conformance and CodingKeys mapping, the JSON snake_case field names cannot be correctly mapped to Swift camelCase properties. Additionally, tool inputs and results can contain arbitrary JSON structures that need a type-erased wrapper.

risks: AnyCodable using Any type loses compile-time type safety
NSNull usage may cause issues with Sendable conformance in strict mode
Recursive AnyCodable decode could stack overflow on maliciously nested input
mitigations: Document AnyCodable usage patterns and provide typed accessor extensions
Test Sendable conformance with Swift strict concurrency checking enabled
Add maximum nesting depth check in AnyCodable decoder init
risk_register.blast_radius: Low - HookInput is a pure data type with no side effects. Bugs would only affect hook input parsing not system state.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If AnyCodable proves problematic, replace with JSONSerialization and [String: Any] dictionaries with explicit JSON value casting at usage sites
